headline: Markets closed for weekend; focus shifts to 20 upcoming IPOs and key corporate actions this week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 28 September.

why: Indian stock markets remain closed today due to the weekend schedule.
Investors are preparing for the busiest primary market week of the year with 20 new IPOs.
Multiple corporate actions including dividends and bonus issues are scheduled for the coming week.
Global and geopolitical developments are being monitored as diplomacy continues in the Middle East.
whatHappening: 20 new IPO issues are opening for subscription in the upcoming week.
10 stocks including SAIL and IGL are turning ex-record date for dividend and bonus announcements.
R Systems International features among the prominent dividend stocks to watch this week.
External Affairs Minister Jaishankar emphasized shaping national AI ecosystems and defending against terrorism at UNGA.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 28 September. Market focus shifts to the busiest week of the year with 20 new IPOs opening for subscription. Stocks like SAIL, IGL, and R Systems International are in focus due to upcoming dividend and bonus ex-record dates.
